seat.en: This little patch of firelight is lovely.

seat.zh: 我坐这边，给你留些地方。 (o_o)
seat.en: I'll settle here. There's room beside me. (o_o)

seat.zh: 靠近一点，衣角别碰着火。
seat.en: Come closer, but mind your hem.

seat.zh: 坐稳了，心也慢慢安静下来。
seat.en: There. Sitting down helps the day settle.
I can see everyone from this seat. (*_*)

seat.zh: 火边有你们，便不觉得空。
seat.en: A circle of familiar faces. That's enough.
Let's get comfortable. Nothing needs hurrying.
I'll keep you company here. (o_o)

wait.zh: 等一等，热气还在慢慢升。
wait.en: A little longer. The heat is still finding its way through.

wait.zh: 不用急，火有自己的节奏。
wait.en: Let the fire take its time.

wait.zh: 等饭的这会儿也很舒服。 (>_<)
wait.en: Even this quiet wait feels nice. (>_<)
We can warm our hands meanwhile.
I'm happy to wait another moment.
Hear that soft crackle? We have a little time.

wait.zh: 还没好，我们聊点轻松的。 (o_o)
wait.en: While it cooks, tell me something small. (o_o)

wait.zh: 有大家一起等，时间便软了。
wait.en: Waiting feels gentler with company.

smell.en: The lovely smell has found our side of the fire.
That aroma feels like a blanket. (>_<)
Such a delicate little waft.
There it is again, beyond the smoke.
I caught myself leaning toward that smell. (^_^)

smell.zh: 空气里都是暖暖的味道。
smell.en: The air smells warm and welcoming.

smell.zh: 闻到香气，等着也不难了。
smell.en: That makes the waiting rather pleasant.

smell.zh: 香味像在叫我们别走远。 (>_<)
smell.en: The smell is asking us to stay nearby. (>_<)

first_bite.en: One small bite to begin with.
Oh, that's beautifully warm.
Careful now. This first bite is hot. :-)

first_bite.zh: 尝到了，心里也亮了一点。
first_bite.en: There. A little brightness with that bite.
A gentle breath, then a proper taste.
I like this little beginning.
That first warm bite feels comforting. (>_<)
I'll take a small bite. There's plenty of time.

taste.zh: 火烤出来的味道很温柔。
taste.en: The fire has given it such a gentle flavor.
There's a soft fragrance after that bite. :-)
I can taste the little details while it's warm.
This deserves a few unhurried bites.
We can let a quiet mouthful speak for itself. (-_-)

taste.zh: 我喜欢这口暖暖的滋味。
taste.en: I do like that warm, mellow taste.

taste.zh: 越慢越能尝到里面的香。
taste.en: A slower bite brings out more of the flavor.
That tastes wonderfully comforting. :-)

satisfied.en: I'm nicely full. Thank you for dinner.

satisfied.zh: 胃里暖了，肩膀也松下来。
satisfied.en: A warm stomach, and my shoulders have relaxed.
That was a peaceful little meal. (o_o)

satisfied.zh: 不再惦记吃的了，坐会儿吧。
satisfied.en: I'm content now. Shall we sit a while?

satisfied.zh: 吃饱以后，火光更柔和了。
satisfied.en: The fire seems softer after a meal.
I'm quite content, truly.
I enjoyed that right to the last bite. :-)
Warm and full. A good feeling.

chat.zh: 不用找话题，坐在一起就好。
chat.en: We needn't fill every quiet moment.

chat.zh: 火光落在大家脸上，真好。 (o_o)
chat.en: I like seeing everyone's faces in the firelight. (o_o)

chat.zh: 这一小圈地方，很让人安心。
chat.en: This little circle feels welcoming.

chat.zh: 你们说，我听着呢。
chat.en: Go on. I'm listening.

chat.zh: 听见木柴轻响，便想多坐会儿。 (*_*)
chat.en: That crackle makes me want to linger. (*_*)

chat.zh: 今天的小事，也可以慢慢讲。
chat.en: The small bits of your day are welcome too.

chat.zh: 坐在这里，声音都轻了一点。
chat.en: Even our voices feel softer here.

chat.zh: 这会儿不用忙，陪着就好。 (o_o)
chat.en: For this moment, company is enough. (o_o)

depart.zh: 差不多该起身啦，慢慢来。
depart.en: Nearly time to get up. Take your time.
Let's carry a little of this warmth with us.
Mind your footing as we leave the fire. (>_<)

depart.zh: 坐得很舒服，也该伸伸腿了。
depart.en: That was lovely. My legs could use a stretch.
Thank you for sitting here with me.
Getting ready to go? Mind those hems.
There's no rush getting to our feet. (o_o)

depart.zh: 这一顿就好好收在心里。
depart.en: I'll keep this quiet dinner close.

seat.en: Made it! Front row for dinner!
Perfect seat. I can see the whole crew! (o_o)

seat.zh: 坐好了，我的肚子也到场了！
seat.en: Me and my stomach are officially seated!

seat.zh: 挪一点点，我也要围进来！
seat.en: Scoot over a tiny bit. I'm joining the circle!

seat.zh: 今天的快乐从这个座位开始！ (*_*)
seat.en: This seat looks like the start of a good time! (*_*)
Yes! A proper little circle!

seat.zh: 我要坐得离香味近一点！
seat.en: I picked the seat closest to the good smells!
Feet parked. Dinner mode on! (o_o)

wait.zh: 等饭也是一项集体活动！
wait.en: Waiting for dinner is a team sport!

wait.zh: 我没有催，我只是看得很认真！
wait.en: I'm not rushing it. I'm supervising enthusiastically!

wait.zh: 再等等，我跟肚子商量好了！ (>_<)
wait.en: My stomach and I have agreed to wait! (>_<)

wait.zh: 谁能让这几秒走快一点呀！
wait.en: Could these seconds please pick up the pace?

wait.zh: 先坐住，不能被香气拐走！
wait.en: Stay seated. Don't let the smell carry you away!
I'm counting sparks to pass the time!

wait.zh: 等着等着，期待值又涨啦！ (o_o)
wait.en: Somehow I'm getting more excited just waiting! (o_o)

wait.zh: 好饭值得等，我努力值得！
wait.en: Good food takes patience. I'm practicing!

smell.en: Whoa! The smell got here before dinner!
My nose would like to volunteer! (>_<)

smell.zh: 这香气，是冲着我来的吧！
smell.en: That delicious smell knows exactly where I'm sitting!

smell.zh: 闻到啦，我整个人都精神了！
smell.en: One whiff and I'm fully awake!
Even the air is getting tasty! (^_^)
That smell just made me sit up straight!

smell.zh: 别看我，是鼻子在往前凑！
smell.en: That's my nose leaning forward, not me!

smell.zh: 这一阵香，必须大声表扬！ (>_<)
smell.en: That aroma deserves a round of applause! (>_<)

first_bite.zh: 开吃！第一口归我自己尝！
first_bite.en: Here we go! First bite, full attention!
Ooh, hot! Happy! Both!

first_bite.zh: 吃到了！等饭选手成功啦！ :-)
first_bite.en: A bite at last! The waiting champion wins! :-)
First bite landed. Happiness confirmed!
Hang on. This first nibble needs focus!
Well, hello there, delicious first bite!
Opening bite caught and appreciated! (>_<)
One bite first. Words later!

taste.zh: 这一口香得很有存在感！
taste.en: Now that's a flavor that makes an entrance!
There's a whole party in this bite! :-)

taste.zh: 火烤的香，果然很会招人！
taste.en: Grilled flavor really knows how to make friends!

taste.zh: 这滋味让我想认真点头！
taste.en: That deserves a very serious happy nod!

taste.zh: 好吃得我都顾不上比划啦！ (-_-)
taste.en: Too busy enjoying this to wave my arms! (-_-)

taste.zh: 这一口值得我坐直了夸！
taste.en: Let me sit up properly to praise this bite!
The flavor is doing little laps in my mouth!
Verdict: this bite has excellent energy! :-)

satisfied.en: Full stomach, full happiness meter!

satisfied.zh: 肚子终于不跟我抢话了！
satisfied.en: My stomach has finally stopped interrupting!
Dinner has reached its happy destination! (o_o)

satisfied.zh: 我现在是一只满足的小团子！
satisfied.en: I am now a very content little dumpling!

satisfied.zh: 吃完啦，能量满满地坐着！
satisfied.en: Meal finished. Fully powered sitting begins!

satisfied.zh: 好满足，先让我笑一会儿！
satisfied.en: So content. Give me a moment to grin!

satisfied.zh: 这一顿吃得心花都开啦！ :-)
satisfied.en: That dinner has me blooming with happiness! :-)

satisfied.zh: 饱了饱了，我的表情已经说明一切！
satisfied.en: My grin tells the whole delicious story!

chat.zh: 来嘛，谁讲个小小的趣事！
chat.en: Who's got a tiny story for the circle?

chat.zh: 火星一跳，我也想跟着点头！ (o_o)
chat.en: Every little spark makes me want to bob along! (o_o)

chat.zh: 我们这一圈，看着就很热闹！
chat.en: Just look at our excellent little gathering!

chat.zh: 你们不说话，我也能开心坐着！
chat.en: I can enjoy a quiet circle too. Honestly!

chat.zh: 要不每人说一个今天喜欢的东西！ (*_*)
chat.en: Name one thing you liked today. I'll listen! (*_*)

chat.zh: 我喜欢这种凑在一起的感觉！
chat.en: I like this whole being-together business!

chat.zh: 这会儿连发呆都很有气氛！
chat.en: Even daydreaming feels festive here!

chat.zh: 我在听呢，耳朵也吃饱精神啦！ (o_o)
chat.en: I'm listening! My ears have plenty of energy! (o_o)

depart.zh: 好啦，准备起身活动一下！
depart.en: All right! Nearly time to unpark ourselves!

depart.zh: 这场火边聚会，给个笑脸！
depart.en: A big grin for this little fireside gathering!

depart.zh: 大家起身时别踩到自己裙角！ (>_<)
depart.en: Watch those hems when you stand up! (>_<)

depart.zh: 让我先伸个超级小懒腰！
depart.en: One spectacularly small stretch before we go!
Let's leave with the same happy energy!

depart.zh: 站起来以后，脚可别还在偷懒！
depart.en: Feet, get ready. Sitting duty is almost over!

depart.zh: 这一圈真不错，我记住这份热闹啦！ (o_o)
depart.en: That was an excellent circle. Lovely company! (o_o)

depart.zh: 准备撤离座位，笑容继续营业！
depart.en: Seat closing soon. Grin staying open!

seat.en: Tools down for a moment. Let's sit.

seat.zh: 这个位置稳当，我坐这里。 (o_o)
seat.en: Good, steady spot. This will do. (o_o)

seat.zh: 先安顿好，吃饭也要认真。
seat.en: Get settled. A meal deserves attention too.
Good. There's a place for everyone.
Sit securely and give the fire some room. (*_*)

seat.zh: 这一会儿可以踏实歇脚。
seat.en: We can give our feet a proper rest here.
A full circle by the fire. Good to see.

seat.zh: 我也坐下，今天不站着吃。 (o_o)
seat.en: I'll sit too. No eating on my feet. (o_o)

wait.en: Still cooking. Fussing won't help it along.
Let it cook through. Better that way.
A few minutes' rest is useful too. (>_<)
Stay settled. No need to keep getting up.
Heat needs time to do its work.

wait.zh: 这会儿歇着，手也松一松。
wait.en: Rest your hands while we wait.
Not quite ready. A little patience. (o_o)
It's good to wait for a meal in peace.

smell.en: There's the aroma. Worth the wait.
Smells good. The fire is doing its job. (>_<)
That's a good, hearty smell.
Even from this seat, I can smell it well.
Grilled food has an honest smell. (^_^)

smell.zh: 这香气让人想好好吃饭。
smell.en: That smell deserves a proper appetite.
A hot meal in the air. Reassuring.
My nose has the news before my mouth. (>_<)

first_bite.en: First bite. No need to rush a meal.
A warm bite. That's reassuring.
One careful mouthful to start. :-)
There. A comfortably warm bite.
Let me give this mouthful my attention.
Eating now. We can talk in a moment.
A quick breath first. Mind the heat. (>_<)
First bite taken. Good.

taste.en: A good, honest mouthful.
Chew properly. It's better than hurrying. :-)
Warm and substantial. Just right.
You can taste what the fire has added.
That flavor needs no fancy description. (-_-)
Taking it mouthful by mouthful suits me.
Good flavor. Settles you down nicely.

taste.zh: 认真吃，才不辜负这一份。 :-)
taste.en: Give a good meal the attention it deserves. :-)

satisfied.en: Finished. Take a proper rest before getting up.
A full stomach makes things feel steadier.
That was a good, substantial meal. (o_o)

satisfied.zh: 吃饱了，不用急着找事做。
satisfied.en: I'm full. Work can wait another moment.
A proper meal, properly enjoyed.

satisfied.zh: 饱了，肩背也能放松一下。
satisfied.en: Full now. Time to ease my shoulders.
That dinner was worth sitting down for. :-)

satisfied.zh: 吃完了，先把这口气歇匀。
satisfied.en: Meal finished. Let's catch our breath.

chat.zh: 火边这会儿，先不谈活。
chat.en: For once, let's leave work out of the conversation.

chat.zh: 大家坐得安稳，我就放心。 (o_o)
chat.en: Everyone looks settled. Good. (o_o)

chat.zh: 听着木头响，脑子也歇一歇。
chat.en: Let the wood crackle. Give your thoughts a rest.

chat.zh: 这圈人坐在一起，挺像样。
chat.en: We make a decent little gathering.

chat.zh: 闲话也可以慢慢说。 (*_*)
chat.en: No need to hurry a conversation either. (*_*)

chat.zh: 有事明天再想，这会儿歇着。
chat.en: Later things can wait. This is a rest.

chat.zh: 我听着呢，不用急着讲完。
chat.en: I'm listening. Take your time finishing.

chat.zh: 火暖，人齐，这样就不错。 (o_o)
chat.en: Warm fire, good company. That'll do. (o_o)

depart.en: Nearly time. Get up carefully.

depart.zh: 歇过了，准备活动活动腿。
depart.en: A decent rest. Time to ease our legs soon.

depart.zh: 离座前看看脚边，别绊着。 (>_<)
depart.en: Check your footing before leaving your seat. (>_<)
A solid meal. Thank you.
When we leave, keep those hems clear of the fire.
We've been sitting a while. Stretch first.
Getting up soon. No need to rush ahead. (o_o)

depart.zh: 这会儿歇得不错，够踏实。
depart.en: That was a proper, welcome rest.

seat.zh: 我坐这里。火光没那么晃眼。
seat.en: This seat. The light is softer here.
This corner suits me. (o_o)
A little quiet space is all I need.
Settled. I can hear the wood crackling.
No need to call. I'm here. (*_*)
A place by the fire is enough.
I can see everyone from here.
Mm. Warm here. (o_o)

wait.en: Another moment.
The fire is busy. We can rest.
Waiting is all right. (>_<)
No rush. Listen to the fire.
This little pause is comfortable.
I can be patient.
Not ready. A reason to sit a little longer. (o_o)
Let the fire take its time.

smell.en: I smell it. A warm scent.
The smell reached this side. (>_<)
Mm. My nose noticed first.
No need to lean closer.
Something lovely behind the smoke. (^_^)
The air hints at dinner.
A faint aroma. It lingers.
That smell makes waiting easy. (>_<)

first_bite.en: Just a small first bite.
Mm. There it is.
Hot. Slowly. :-)
A quiet mouthful.
Give me a moment with this bite.
First bite... good.
A little cooler. Then a bite. (>_<)
Oh. Warmth spreading.

taste.en: Let that flavor linger.
A clear, simple taste. :-)
Mm. The flavor of the fire.
No words needed to appreciate it.
A good mouthful. (-_-)
Warm. Just right.
Slowly. The flavor is still there.
I like the quiet aftertaste. :-)

satisfied.en: Finished. Content.
Warm inside now.
Mm. Enough. Quite enough. (o_o)
Nothing missing in this moment.
Full. I'll sit a little longer.
A lovely meal. Thank you.
A settled, comfortable feeling. :-)
Full stomach. Even fewer words.

chat.zh: 不用一直说话。
chat.en: We don't have to keep talking.

chat.zh: 火声，够热闹了。 (o_o)
chat.en: The crackle is company enough. (o_o)

chat.zh: 你们聊。我听。
chat.en: You talk. I'll listen.

chat.zh: 这一圈，没有空。
chat.en: This circle doesn't feel empty.

chat.zh: 安静一点，也很好。 (*_*)
chat.en: A little quiet is good too. (*_*)

chat.zh: 坐着就行。
chat.en: Just sitting is fine.

chat.zh: 火星飘上去，又不见了。
chat.en: A spark rises. Then it's gone.

chat.zh: 嗯，我还在听。 (o_o)
chat.en: Mm. Still listening. (o_o)

depart.en: Nearly over. Stand up slowly.
The warmth will linger.
Getting ready to go. Thanks for the company. (>_<)
One last look at the fire before standing.
Time to stretch my legs.
A quiet while. A good while.
No hurry leaving this seat. (o_o)
Mm. Keep a little warmth.
